'''Pikachu Shocks Back issue 1''' is the fifth monthly issue of the manga series [[The Electric Tale of Pikachu]] to be released by [[VIZ Media]]. It contains the fifth chapter of the manga, ''[[ET05|The Human Race and the Pokémon Race]]''. 

The contents of this issue was included as part of {{vol|Electric Tale of Pikachu|2}} along with [[ET06]], [[ET07]], and [[ET08]].

* Brock meets the [[Sensational Sisters]].
* Ash and Misty meet [[Lara Laramie]].
